name: Lexus
verdict: Luxury-car brand of Toyota Motor Corporation. Toyota states in its FY2026 Form 20-F that, to the extent known, it is not owned or controlled, directly or indirectly, by another corporation, any foreign government or any natural or legal person. Nothing found.
note: Lexus supplies the RC F LMGT3 cars that Akkodis ASP Team enters in the FIA World Endurance Championship, per Lexus's own newsroom. The listed-company ownership record cites Toyota's FY2026 Form 20-F.
